in_arabic.name: أتيقون
in_arabic.long_meaning: أتيقون اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي، مشتق من الفعل 'أَتَقَى' بمعنى 'أَحَاطَ بِشَيْءٍ' أو 'أَخَافَ مِن شَيْءٍ' و'أَقَامَ عَلَيْهِ'.  يُنسب هذا الاسم إلى مَن يَحَظُّ بِأَمانةٍ، وِصِدْقٍ، وِعَزْمٍ.  ويُشير إلى شخصٍ قويٍّ، مُتَقَىٍّ، وَمُتَوَثِّقٍ.  لا يوجد ذكرٍ لهذا الاسم في القرآن الكريم، لكنه يحمل معنىً إيجابياً و يُستخدم في المجتمعات الإسلامية بشكلٍ شائعٍ.

in_urdu.name: اتيقون
in_urdu.meaning: حِفَظ، امانت، صدق و عزم والا
in_urdu.long_meaning: اتيقون  یہ ایک عربی اصالت کا نام ہے جو عمل 'اتقّى'  سے نکلا ہے جس کا معنی ہے 'کوئی چیز کو پکڑ لینا' یا 'کوئی چیز سے ڈرنا'. اس نام سے وہ شخص مراد ہے جو امانت، صدق، اور عزم والا ہو۔ یہ نام اسلامی تہذیب میں عام ہے۔

in_hindi.name: अतीकून
in_hindi.long_meaning: अतीकून एक आर्यावर्त मूल नाम है जो अरबी मूल से लिया गया है। इसका अर्थ है 'सुरक्षा'  'निष्ठा' और 'दृढ़ संकल्पित'। यह नाम उन लोगों के लिए उपयुक्त है जो अत्यधिक ईमानदार, सिद्धांतों पर अडिग और अपने वचनों पर अमल करने वाले होते हैं। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में लोकप्रिय है।

in_pashto.name: اتيقون
in_pashto.long_meaning: اتيقون  یوه پښتو نوم دی چې د عربي ژبه څخه راغلی دی.  دا نوم د 'اتقّى'  د  واژې څخه راغلی دی، چې په پښتو کې د 'تکل، پنه کړه کار' د معنا ته وړاندې کېږي.  دا نوم د انانی، پوهند، او خپل کړه کار  د  شخص د لپاره ورکول کېږي.

in_english.name: Atiqoon
in_english.long_meaning: Atiqoon is an Arabic masculine name derived from the root word 'atqa,' meaning 'to be secure' or 'to take refuge.' It signifies trustworthiness, reliability, and steadfastness. The name embodies qualities of strength, loyalty, and resilience. While not explicitly mentioned in the Quran, it carries a positive connotation and is widely used in Muslim cultures across the world.

data.cultural_impact: The name Atiqoon holds a significant cultural meaning in the Islamic world, particularly in the Arabic language. It is an appellation that carries respect and reverence to the person bearing the title, reflecting their age and experience. In the traditional Arab culture, age is highly valued, and the elderly are often considered the keepers of wisdom and knowledge. The title Atiqoon signifies a person's esteemed position in the society, as well as their role in sharing their learned experiences and guiding the younger generations.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Atiqoon holds a deeper and more profound meaning. It embodies the concept of the ancient and wise being a vessel of divine guidance. The aging process is seen as a journey towards greater knowledge, enlightenment, and wisdom. The title Atiqoon signifies the individual's dedication and commitment towards seeking knowledge and understanding of the divine. It represents the idea that the more one grows older, the greater their connection to the spiritual and the divine, as they continue to learn, evolve, and become wiser in their understanding of the world and their role in it. The name Atiqoon, then, becomes a symbol of spiritual growth and enlightenment, emphasizing the importance of learning and seeking knowledge as a means to connect with the divine and lead a purposeful and meaningful life.
